commands.purpose: Validate evidence manifest paths exist in repo
commands.command: python -c "import yaml, pathlib; d=yaml.safe_load(open('.local/evidences/superpowers-agentic-autonomy/evidence-manifest.yaml')); missing=[p for item in d.get('artifacts',[]) for p in [item['path']] if not pathlib.Path(p).exists()]; print(f'missing: {len(missing)}')"

commands.purpose: Validate review ZIP includes all declared artifacts (manifest-vs-ZIP)
commands.command:
python -c "
import zipfile, yaml, pathlib
decl = yaml.safe_load(open('.local/evidences/superpowers-agentic-autonomy/evidence-declaration.yaml'))
declared = {item['path'] for item in decl.get('artifacts', [])}
zf = zipfile.ZipFile(list(pathlib.Path('.local/supervisor/reviews/superpowers-agentic-autonomy').glob('*.zip'))[0])
in_zip = set(zf.namelist())
missing = declared - in_zip
print(f'manifest_missing_count={len(missing)}')
assert len(missing) == 0
"

commands.purpose: GitHub CLI check (authenticated only; non-blocking if unavailable)
